description: This file defines a REST controller class UtilityControllers that provides health check and report summary endpoints for the service. It uses Spring annotations to handle web requests and Swagger annotations for API documentation. The class interacts with ProjectRepository to retrieve project data.

classes.name: UtilityControllers
classes.description: A REST controller exposing health status and project report endpoints.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple health status indicator, 'UP'.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Provides a summary report with the total number of projects.
